source-ab31f6a5382d61d0aabd4751.review_note: ⚖️ Official law: Accessibility Requirements for Products and Services Act — copy hosted by KZP; Articles 68 and 73.

claims.assertion: The Bulgarian accessibility law defines covered product and service categories separately.
claims.review_note: Scope recorded for this country's baseline; individual applicability still needs sector-level verification.

claims.assertion: Covered service providers must provide the public with information about how services meet accessibility requirements; Annex 5 places the assessment information in terms and conditions or an equivalent document.
claims.scope: Covered services; public information can appear in terms and conditions or an equivalent document.
claims.review_note: This verifies a statutory public information duty, not a dedicated public page or monitoring-body instruction.

claims.assertion: A Bulgarian EAA monitoring body requires a dedicated public page comparable to a WAD accessibility statement.
claims.review_note: No explicit government or competent monitoring-body instruction requiring a dedicated page has been located. The WAD statement on a government agency's own site would not establish this EAA requirement. Existing Yes is retained: absence of a public primary-source confirmation does not disprove information obtained through agency correspondence or personal contact. Request the original correspondence or attribution before changing this value.

claims.assertion: The competent authority requires EAA accessibility information to be supplied to a member of the public only on request.
claims.review_note: Article 50(2) describes information made available to the public; no explicit public-on-request instruction from a competent body has been established.

claims.assertion: On a justified request, a service provider must provide the competent authority information needed to demonstrate conformity.
claims.scope: Covered services; information supplied to competent authority on request.
claims.review_note: This request-based duty is distinct from the public information duty in Article 50(2).

claims.assertion: Consumers and disability organisations may send complaints or reports about alleged violations in writing on paper or electronically to the competent product market surveillance or service authority.
claims.scope: Competent authority depends on product or service sector.
claims.review_note: This statute specifies recipients and paper/electronic form but gives no actual address, email, or tool. It does not by itself verify a usable route.

claims.assertion: For the Consumer Protection Commission's e-commerce service remit, the commission publishes a general online complaint form and accepts complaints in person at its counter.
claims.scope: E-commerce services under Article 2(2)(7), assigned to the Consumer Protection Commission by Article 54(1)(10). Other sectors need their own routes.
claims.review_note: Rechecked 2026-09-23: contacts page reachable; https://kzp.bg/en/signals redirects to https://kzp.bg/en/login (reachable login). Account required; EAA-specific intake behind login and accepted complaint languages unknown. An English page does not prove English submissions are accepted. claims.review_note:
Agent /root/bulgarian_language started with fork_turns=none; original URLs and proposed wording only, no research conclusions/statuses or PR discussion. Initial Correction needed: broad banking descriptions omit statutory subsets and transport descriptions omit covered-element limits. Article 54(1)(7): “т. 25, буква „б“” = item25 letter(b), referencing supplementary provisions §1(1): FSC/deputy covers investment-services subset. Article54(1)(8): “т. 25, букви „в“ – „д“” = item25 letters(c)–(e): BNB covers payment services, payment-account services and electronic money. Article54(1)(10): “т. 25, буква „а“” = item25 letter(a): KZP covers credit agreements plus e-commerce. “договори за кредит” = credit agreements; covered consumer credit includes ordinary and immovable-property credit. Article2(2)(3): “следните елементи” = the following elements; transport wording narrowed to covered elements, bus/rail additionally include Article2(2)(4) urban/suburban/regional terminals. Culture: ebook-related software excludes e-reader software under §1(1)(7). ДАМТН institutional summary supported; Article34(1) formally designates chair acting through agency bodies. Communications/media scopes supported. Article50(2): “писмена и устна форма” = written and oral form. Annex5(1): “общите условия” = general terms. Final wording separates public accessible written/oral information from inclusion in terms and conditions/equivalent document. Article53(1): “При обосновано искане” = upon a justified request. Dedicated-page qualification limited to these provisions supported. KZP contacts Внимание paragraph identifies electronic form or personal submission at counter. Login redirect observed; EAA-specific intake remains unconfirmed, as qualified in table. Final corrected transport, banking, software and information wording rechecked: Supported. Local authority names retained; old broad bilingual scope parentheses replaced to avoid mismatch. Corrections rely on explicit official cross-references; existing Yes and reporting qualifications preserved. No completeness certification. Prior Bulgarian-fluent-review follow-up is superseded by this comparison. Exact final public row (unchanged source-language names retained): Bulgaria ✔️ Yes (Source needed)
  • State Agency for Metrological and Technical Surveillance (ДАМТН) – market surveillance of covered products.
  • The Communications Regulation Commission – for electronic communications services, with the exception of transmission services used for the provision of machine-to-machine services; (Комисията за регулиране на съобщенията – за електронни съобщителни услуги с изключение на услуги за предаване, използвани за предоставянето на услуги машина-машина;)
  • The Electronic Media Council – for services providing access to audio-visual media services; (Съвета за електронни медии – за услуги за предоставяне на достъп до аудио-визуални медийни услуги;)
  • Directorate General "Civil Aviation Administration" – covered elements of air passenger transport services. (Главна дирекция "Гражданска въздухоплавателна администрация")
  • Executive Agency "Automobile Administration" – covered bus passenger-transport elements, including urban, suburban and regional terminal services. (Изпълнителна агенция "Автомобилна администрация")
  • Executive Agency "Railway Administration" – covered rail passenger-transport elements, including urban, suburban and regional terminal services. (Изпълнителна агенция "Железопътна администрация")
  • Executive Agency "Maritime Administration" – covered elements of water passenger transport services. (Изпълнителна агенция "Морска администрация")
  • The Financial Supervision Commission and the Deputy Chairman of the Financial Supervision Commission, Head of the "Investment Activity Supervision" Department – covered investment-services subset of consumer banking (Article 54(1)(7)). (Комисията за финансов надзор)
  • The Bulgarian National Bank – payment services, payment-account services and electronic money (Article 54(1)(8)). (Българската народна банка)
  • The Ministry of Culture – e-books and related software, excluding e-reader software. (Министерството на културата)
  • Consumer Protection Commission – e-commerce and covered consumer-credit agreements (Article 54(1)(10)). (Комисията за защита на потребителите)
  • Consumer Protection Commission (КЗП), e-commerce: general online complaint form (login required) or submit in person at a КЗП counter.
  • Other competent authorities: ❓ Unknown reporting routes.

Accessibility information: Bulgarian accessibility law, Article 50(2) and Annex 5: covered service providers make accessibility information publicly available in accessible written and oral forms and include it in general terms and conditions or an equivalent document. Article 53(1) separately requires conformity information to be supplied to the competent authority on a justified request. Neither provision specifies a dedicated public page.

Reporting scope: The law assigns e-commerce service oversight to КЗП (Articles 2(2)(7), 54(1)(10)). The general complaint form’s EAA-specific intake has not been confirmed.

⚖️ EAA implementing law: Закон за изискванията за достъпност на продукти и услуги.

This is separate AI fidelity review, not independent human approval, legal interpretation or a full renewed country audit.
